Role: PLAYER\_ROLE\_TANK · Primary stat: STAT\_INTELLECT

## Description

```text
### OVERVIEW
You've glimpsed the Void but stand protected by the Arcane. As an Eldritch Knight, you'll cleave through foes with lethal arcane strikes that restore mana and blast foes. A juggernaut of Arcane might, you stand ready to defend your allies and fight back against the Void.

How to use your Legendary Enchant:

Eldritch Effusion: This enchant has two key interactions that benefit your toolkit. First, casting the spell will restore 20% of your missing mana. Second, you are granted Elcritch Weapon, which imbues your Main Hand weapon to trigger a wave of high-threat arcane damage. It is important to note that other imbues, such as Windfury or FLametobgue, will overwrite this effect.

Eldritch Wrath: This transforms your Holy Wrath into Eldritch Wrath, causing it to deal Arcane Damage and reduce enemy Attack Power.

Phasing: This procs from the base benefits of your Legendary Mystic Enchant. Simply taking physical damage will trigger this effect.

### ITEMIZATION
Stamina > Block Value > Intellect > Strength

### ROTATION
1. MYSTIC KNIGHT  (Legendary: Eldritch Knight)  -  TANK, melee
-------------------------------------------------
Plate, shield, one-handed sword. Stats: Stamina > Block Value > Intellect > Strength.
Enchants swap in: Deconstruct (for Devastate), Consecration (Emanate), Eldritch Wrath
(for Holy Wrath), and they grant Eldritch Effusion and Flesh Hook.

In combat:
 1. If channeling Invocation and any enemy turns to someone else -> stop the channel
 2. Mana-forged Barrier, if missing
 3. Seal of Wisdom, if missing
 4. Eldritch Effusion, if Eldritch Weapon is missing
 5. Devotion Aura, if missing (always on)
 6. Pain Suppression on itself, at critical health
 7. Dispersion, at critical health
 8. Evasion, at low health
 9. Pain Suppression on a group member at critical health
10. Flesh Hook, on a target that is not attacking the tank
11. Challenging Shout, on a target that is not attacking the tank
12. Intercept, then Charge, when the target is out of melee range
13. Cleanse group members
14. Capacitor Totem (lands at its feet), with 3+ enemies close by
15. Brilliance Aura, when 2+ group members are below 30% mana
16. Invocation, at low mana while every enemy is on the tank
17. Judgement of Wisdom
18. Consecration (Emanate)
19. Eldritch Wrath
20. Deconstruct (never Devastate)
21. Arcane Orb, with 2+ enemies close by
22. Arcane Explosion, with 2+ enemies close by
23. Arcane Barrage (single-target filler)
24. Sinister Strike (melee filler)

Out of combat: Mana-forged Barrier, Mage Armor, Seal of Wisdom, Eldritch Effusion,
Devotion Aura, Blessing of Sanctuary, Felguard (or Voidwalker before level 56),
Soul Link, Arcane Intellect / Power Word: Fortitude / Mark of the Wild on the group,
Cleanse.

### MACROS
/cast [@cursor] Capacitor Totem

/cast [@cursor] Solar Beam

/cast [@player] Angelic Feather

### NOTES
Arcane Orb: Try to position mobs near a wall and cast your Arcane Orb toward it. If done correctly, the orb and the mobs stay against the wall and take constant damage. BE CAREFUL! Poorly cast Arcane Orb can pull multiple packs and wipe your group.

Dispel Curse and Cleanse: Remove debuffs from yourself and can be used to remove CCs like Polymorph or Sleep from you DPS and Healer.

Pain Suppression, Guardian Spirit: These are your other defensive cooldowns. They have the added benefit that you can cast them on teammates to save them from potential death.

Brilliance Aura prevents you from and your group from running out of mana.

Divine Sacrifice with Talent is an amazing group or raid cooldown.

Use Voidewalker for physical damage and Felhunter for magic damage.

Cpacitor Totem provides an additional stun with a low cooldown.
```
